1. Before your purchase, you can try our Product for free.

2. BT downloading and crawlers are not allowed.

3. After purchase, your days will be increased based on previous days..

4. GLaDOS runs Domain Blocker(?), to ensure your cyber-security and block fakenews, propoganda, extremist and hatred content througth a reasonable way.

5. Traffic resets on day 1st.

6. Plan traffic counts the total data our servers transfer and encrypt to complete your proxy requests (not just the file size) — for example, downloading a 1 GB file typically consumes about 2–2.2 GB of plan traffic.

7. Netflix Unlocking is ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY for longterm.

8. Overage: When monthly traffic is exhausted, the system will deduct days from your remaining balance to exchange for extra traffic (corresponding days per 10GB).

9. Max bandwidth is the peak speed, not a guaranteed rate. Sustained high-speed or multi-device usage is checked by our throttle engine, see the published thresholds in Rate Limits.
